en: Sepia-toned panoramic view of a rural village in a hilly landscape. In the foreground are ploughed fields and a road lined with small trees where a few people and a cart or animals are visible. In the middle distance stand scattered village houses, some half-timbered, along with a tall industrial chimney emitting smoke. Further back, a church tower rises among trees and more buildings, giving the impression of a small German village and its castle and church. Red printed German text appears at the top of the card.
